3518-4812-5131-5241.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter as a Ninja copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1168-3000-3510-4875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
1168-3000-3510-4875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

4279-6248-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6248-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

978-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5233-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

1251-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2060-2325-4222-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Soulmender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Soulmender.
2060-2325-4222-6996.description:
Activate Soulmender by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Soulmender.
Repeat.

851-5086-5183-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-5086-5183-5231-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1409-2933-4478-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-4478-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4004-4890-7149.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Dack's Duplicate enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Dack's Duplicate leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Dack's Duplicate from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-6528-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

6323-7019.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Holding priority, cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}, causing Jumbo Cactuar to fight a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to gain an amount of {R}  equal to the excess damage. You won't lose this mana as steps and phases end this turn.

851-2034-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
851-2034-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

549-856-4659-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2647-3976-6852.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2647-3976-6852.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Warrior's Oath and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Discontinuity and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Warrior's Oath and Discontinuity noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Warrior's Oath without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Discontinuity without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1477-2034-2558-3490.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

372-1734-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Fiend Hunter
372-1734-4200.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering Fiend Hunter's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fiend Hunter trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

282-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-4659-5365.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat from step 3.
282-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4659-5933.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

372-3277-4598.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-3277-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

165-647-1069-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-647-1069-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

804-1339-2034-5185.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of The Locust God.
804-1339-2034-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger twice.
Resolve each of the Sakashima the Impostor and The Locust God triggers, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2871-4280-5195.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist, Veyran and Birgi trigger twice each.
Resolve both Birgi triggers, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1368-2706-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
1368-2706-3883.description:
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw seven cards, then create seven Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

792-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {1}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

12-3266-4550-5158.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
12-3266-4550-5158.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Uprising trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

628-1242.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Cinderhaze Wretch dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
